probe_mechanism: Macros are injected by rewriting rasterization/include/depreg_probe.h per variant (build_fast.sh). Editing the .cuh recompiles only backward.o via ninja depfiles (fast).

macros.BWD_DEPREG_NORECUR: ORACLE: removes warp.shfl_up transmittance/color/grad/last_contributor recurrence AND intra-lane transmittance*=one_minus_alpha / color_pixel_after-=... carry-over (sets transmittance=1.0, last_contributor=block_size_blend). Semantically INVALID for training; timing only.
macros.BWD_DEPREG_NOCOLOR: ORACLE: disables color/SH gradient accumulation. INVALID for training.
macros.BWD_DEPREG_NOOPACITY: ORACLE: disables opacity gradient accumulation. INVALID for training.
macros.BWD_DEPREG_NOCONIC: ORACLE: disables conic+mean2d gradient accumulation. INVALID for training.
macros.--maxrregcount=N: compiler flag: caps registers/thread to force occupancy sweep.

production_r0: no macro defined; kernel is byte-for-byte the production blend_backward_cu path.
forward_unchanged: instrumentation touches ONLY the backward kernel; forward.cu not modified; R0 forward is bit-identical to production.
